versions.description: DEVICE NOT TESTED. Source lane/025-zero-dropout 79280e763341d03ba43266d3e25dad66f12de860 (tree ab2e16a61c81abbcb6c4a71bd83bf0b5d943c120): a chain slot lasts for the longest playing part in the current pattern (909, 808, both 303s and BREAK), counting length and rate, rounded up to a whole 909 bar. Muted, part-off and empty parts do not extend the slot. Chaining stays live-only and is not saved. Firmware reports 0.0.25, GIT 79280e76. JieLi SDK V1.2.14, X0X_DEV_PADCAL=0. Elite_900 and Pro_900; app 547,880 B; RAM .data+.bss 95,556 of 98,304 B (2,748 B free); pool 335,744 of 344,064 B (8,320 B free, 8,192 B minimum). Bundled Bluetooth controller a334208b (61,552 B, CRC32 564a8f55); package_nightly --check exit 0 for both. Official emu360 gate (fm1-live, 360 MHz, 0 late during the test, worst under 11,609 µs): Elite 11,548 µs PASS, Pro 11,564 µs PASS. These are 52 µs and 76 µs above the 1ec5d683 figures (11,496 / 11,488); that sits inside the same-day passing run-to-run range (about 11,484–11,578 µs). Host suite: 415 ok, 0 FAIL, 1 skip (Pro package tests need a build.sh tree), 0 not-run; chain-longest-playing PASS. The previous 0.0.25 package (nightly-1ec5d683-dev) and 0.0.24.5 stay listed. Owner-operated test build, not production.
